title: Cabbage salad
instructions: is very palatable, but few know how to prepare it properly. The milk and vinegar should be put on to heat in separate sauce-pans; when the vinegar boils, add butter,  sugar,  salt and pepper, and stir in the chopped cabbage; cover, and let scald and steam--not boil--for a moment, meanwhile, remove hot milk from stove, cool a little, and stir in the well-beaten and strained yolks; return to stove, and boil a moment. Dish cabbage and pour custard over
it, stir rapidly with a silver spoon until well mixed, and set immediately in a cold place.
